200.title: Leader of junior coalition partner quits Polish government
200.summary: Leader of junior coalition partner quits Polish government Oct 23, 2026 | Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work!
200.body: Leader of junior coalition partner quits Polish government Oct 23, 2026 | Politics Keep our news free from ads and paywalls by making a donation to support our work! Katarzyna Pełczyńska-Nałęcz, the leader of a junior party in Poland’s ruling coalition, has announced that her resignation from the government and the leadership of her party, the centrist Poland 2050 (Polska 2050), in protest over a parliamentary vote on Thursday. Another junior partner in the ruling coalition, the centre-right Polish People’s Party (PSL), had proposed a bill abolishing two-term limits for mayors. Around half the MPs from Poland 2050, a junior member of Poland’s ruling coalition, have split from the party and formed a new parliamentary caucus.

200.title: Tusk seeks to narrow Poland's trade gap with Vietnam
200.summary: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk began a three-day visit to Vietnam on Saturday, seeking to narrow Poland’s trade deficit and expand opportunities for Polish exporters in Southeast Asia. Polish government figures show imports from Vietnam were nearly 15 times the value of Polish exports in 2025.
200.body: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk began a three-day visit to Vietnam on Saturday, seeking to narrow Poland’s trade deficit and expand opportunities for Polish exporters in Southeast Asia. Their talks will focus on relations, a roadmap toward strategic partnership, barriers facing businesses and access to Vietnam’s market for agricultural and food products, Warsaw said. Polish government figures show imports from Vietnam were nearly 15 times the value of Polish exports in 2025. The trip builds on economic cooperation discussions held in Warsaw last year during a visit by Vietnam’s then-prime minister.

200.summary: At the invitation of Prime Minister Le Minh Hung, the Prime Minister of the Republic of Poland, Donald Tusk, is paying an official visit to Viet Nam from October 24 to 26. This is the first visit by a Polish prime minister to Viet Nam in 16 years, underscoring Poland’s regard for Viet Nam as its most important partner within ASEAN.
200.body: At the invitation of Prime Minister Le Minh Hung, the Prime Minister of the Republic of Poland, Donald Tusk, is paying an official visit to Viet Nam from October 24 to 26. This is the first visit by a Polish prime minister to Viet Nam in 16 years, underscoring Poland’s regard for Viet Nam as its most important partner within ASEAN. The visit aims to consolidate traditional friendly relations, broaden cooperation across various sectors, and usher bilateral ties into a new phase of development.

200.title: Former president of Poland Andrzej Duda instructs on executive decision-making in times of crisis
200.summary: Body This fall, former president of Poland Andrzej Duda came to George Mason University’s Antonin Scalia Law School to teach students a course on executive decision-making in times of crisis. L to R: Former President of Poland Andrzej Duda and Dean Daniel Kelly.
200.body: Body This fall, former president of Poland Andrzej Duda came to George Mason University’s Antonin Scalia Law School to teach students a course on executive decision-making in times of crisis. L to R: Former President of Poland Andrzej Duda and Dean Daniel Kelly. Photo provided Comparing parallel provisions of the U.S. and Polish Constitutions, President Duda explored the differences between Article II’s vesting of executive power and Poland’s “semi-presidential” model. He was elected to the Sejm (the lower house of Poland’s parliament) in 2010 and then to the European Parliament in 2014 before being elected as the sixth President of Poland in 2015, where he served until 2025.

300.title: Poland, Karnataka to tie up for aerospace, defence ventures
300.summary: BENGALURU: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said Poland and Karnataka could collaborate in aerospace, defence and advanced manufacturing during a meeting with Chief Minister DK Shivakumar in Bengaluru on Friday.
300.body: BENGALURU: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said Poland and Karnataka could collaborate in aerospace, defence and advanced manufacturing during a meeting with Chief Minister DK Shivakumar in Bengaluru on Friday. Shivakumar invited Poland to participate as a country partner at the Global Investors Meet 2027.The two leaders met on the sidelines of the India-Poland Business Forum to discuss investment, business and technology opportunities between Poland and Karnataka.Tusk highlighted Karnataka’s potential to serve as a gateway for investments between Poland and India. He noted that both Poland and Karnataka had relatively young workforces and said collaboration could be mutually beneficial.Shivakumar welcomed the proposed Rs80-crore investment by Poland’s TZMO Group in the KIADB industrial area at Vemagal in Kolar district. The MoU was exchanged in the presence of Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk and Karnataka Chief Minister DK Shivakumar.
